jorge: starting a quiet, staggered apply for tenant-lynx (network + IAM + route53). Canary: us-west-2a only. Quiet window 15m. Provider pinned to aws v4.7.0+sha256:77aa88. do NOT merge provider bumps during window, call them out here.

deploybot: plan initiated: https://deploy.logs/infra/tenant-lynx/plan/6310004321 :mag: Plan shows 8 changes, 2 replaces (aws_nat_gateway, aws_route53_record), risk: route53 TTL drop and IAM assumeRole narrowing.

ivy: ack. I'll review the IAM diff and watch for wildcard principals.
samir: we have a blue-green test scheduled in 50m; will hold until you signal.

jorge: added preflight hooks: tfstate snapshot check and a bindings lint. snippet: ```bash
aws s3 ls s3://tf-backups/tenant-lynx/6310004321.snapshot || exit 1
./scripts/check-bindings.sh tenant-lynx || exit 2
```

sec-oncall: IAM lint queued; webhook will post results here.

opsbot: created canary monitor tenant-lynx-canary (p50, dns-error-rate, nat-health). alerts -> #incidents + this thread.

deploybot: preflight apply command: `TF_WORKSPACE=tenant-lynx TF_VAR_env=prod terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -var-file=tenant-lynx.prod.tfvars`

jorge: starting canary apply in us-west-2a now.

deploybot: canary apply started 6310004340.

deploybot: canary apply finished 6310004358 — success. nat gw replaced, route53 ttl lowered, 1 iam policy narrowed.

ivy: iam-lint: narrowed assumeRole, removed a stray wildcard on s3:GetObject. lgtm after small patch confirmation.

jorge: holding before full rollout. samir, your blue-green test stay paused.

samir: paused and standing by.

opsbot: canary metrics: p50 steady, dns-error-rate 0.04%, nat-health ok.

jorge: rolling to full region in 2 waves (us-west-2b then us-west-2c), 10m stagger. rollback criteria: abort and restore tfstate snapshot if dns errors >0.5% for 3m or nat-health fails >12% for 3m. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/infra/tenant-lynx/rollback

sec-oncall: watching audit logs for sts:AssumeRole anomalies.

jorge: adding release note draft: "tenant-lynx: NATGW replacement, DNS TTL update, tightened IAM assumeRole (canary us-west-2a)" :memo: will attach plan diff and canary graphs to the release ticket.

ivy: will post the plan diff after wave 1 completes.

jorge: keeping the thread open for 45m post-rollout. ping here for approvals or to trigger rollback.
